name: @ai-ecoverse/outlook
description: The outlook CLI for jsh. It reads and sends Outlook (Office 365) mail and calendar with a token taken from a logged-in outlook.office.com tab in Chrome, over an existing DevTools Protocol connection (SLICC_CDP_URL, else found: SLICC's Chrome, or 127.0.0.1:9222). `npm install -g` or `pnpm add -g` this folder to put it on PATH.
